sources.title: ELVIS Group, JNCI 1999;91:66–72
sources.audit_note: Primary randomized publication; ≥70 years, stage IIIB/IV, six trial cycles Days 1/8 q21d. 191 randomized, 161 analysed per primary abstract. Trial six-cycle cap not imposed on NCCP.

sources.title: Gridelli et al., European Journal of Cancer 2004;40:2424–2431
sources.audit_note: Primary single-arm publication, 56 patients; 60 weekly first three administrations then 80. No comparator.

sources.title: Jassem et al., Annals of Oncology 2001;12:1375–1381
sources.audit_note: Supporting oral-vs-IV randomized phase II reviewed; IV comparator weekly, not 00232 Days1/8 q21d. No equivalence claim promoted into this suite.

sources.title: Chouaid et al., Lung Cancer Management 2025
sources.audit_note: 247 participants pooled from four historical weekly treatment arms. Descriptive pooled cohort without concurrent pooled control; sponsor-funded. Reviewed for contemporary evidence context.

sources.title: Correction, Lung Cancer Management, 16 April 2026
sources.audit_note: Adds Table2 dose-escalation denominator n211, Table3 response denominator n22, disease-control denominator n142 and event-probability footnotes. No uncaveated quantitative comparative claim.

sources.title: Sandler et al., NEJM 2006;355:2542–2550
sources.audit_note: Primary OS comparison carboplatin/paclitaxel ±15mg/kg q21d bevacizumab; 878 selected patients. OS benefit and pulmonary-bleeding/treatment-related mortality explicitly discussed.

sources.title: Yamamoto et al., Lung Cancer 2021;151:20–24
sources.audit_note: Updated investigator PFS and final OS publication; 152 treated Japanese patients, median follow-up34.7months. PFS improvement without significant OS improvement.
